{
  "name": "multi-day-trip-map",
  "version": "1.4.0",
  "private": true,
  "license": "MIT",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev --webpack --hostname 127.0.0.1",
    "build": "next build --webpack",
    "start": "next start --hostname 127.0.0.1",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "node scripts/run-tests.cjs",
    "desktop:prepare": "npm ci --prefix desktop/app && node scripts/prepare-desktop.cjs",
    "desktop:dev": "electron desktop/app",
    "desktop:pack": "electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.cjs --win --publish never",
    "desktop:build": "npm run desktop:prepare && npm run desktop:pack"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@dnd-kit/core": "^6.3.1",
    "@dnd-kit/sortable": "^10.0.0",
    "@dnd-kit/utilities": "^3.2.2",
    "@radix-ui/react-select": "^2.3.7",
    "better-sqlite3": "^11.10.0",
    "lru-cache": "^11.5.3",
    "lucide-react": "^0.468.0",
    "next": "^16.0.0",
    "openai": "^6.49.0",
    "react": "^19.0.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.0.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@playwright/test": "^1.55.0",
    "@tailwindcss/postcss": "^4.0.0",
    "@types/better-sqlite3": "^9.6.0",
    "@types/node": "^22.0.0",
    "@types/react": "^19.0.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.0.0",
    "electron": "^44.4.5",
    "electron-builder": "^26.15.3",
    "tailwindcss": "^4.0.0",
    "tsx": "^4.20.0",
    "typescript": "^5.7.0"
  }
}
